interview_answer: For 64 resumes: saved 8.5 hours of screening time (₹4,250 cost), reduced the review pool by 60.9%, and improved screening precision from 40% to 65% — estimating 6.2 bad hires prevented (₹3,100,000 saved at industry cost-of-bad-hire benchmark). System is 267.0x faster than manual screening.
disclaimer: Time/cost figures are estimates based on SHRM industry benchmarks. Real validation requires tracking actual hire outcomes at 3-6 months. The feedback_log.csv + retrain_on_feedback() function provides that loop.
